<?php
class UntypedNameNumericGet {
    public function __get($incoming): float|int {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "numeric") { return "3.5"; }
        if ($incoming === "whole") { return "12"; }
        if ($incoming === "truth") { return true; }
        if ($incoming === "bad") { return null; }
        return 2.5;
    }
}
$numeric = new UntypedNameNumericGet;
$selector = "numeric";
echo $numeric->$selector === 3.5 ? "FLOAT;" : "BAD_FLOAT;";
echo $numeric->whole === 12 ? "INT;" : "BAD_INT;";
echo $numeric->truth === 1 ? "BOOL_INT;" : "BAD_BOOL_INT;";
echo $numeric->value === 2.5 ? "DIRECT;" : "BAD_DIRECT;";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $numeric->bad === 0; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "numeric" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
